role_summary: Strategic leadership role focused on end-to-end digital platform implementation, enterprise-scale software delivery, and aligning technology roadmaps with business objectives in the insurance sector.
must_have_requirements: University degree in IT, Computer Science, or related field
12+ years of professional software development experience
Expertise in Java and Spring Boot framework
Extensive experience overseeing full SDLC at enterprise scale
Proficiency in Cloud Platform system development
Deep expertise in API design (RESTful, OpenAPI 3.0/Swagger)
Experience managing Agile teams and cross-functional stakeholders
nice_to_have_requirements: Broad knowledge of insurance industry regulatory and compliance standards
Proven background in digital transformation of customer journeys
Experience with post-implementation review and process optimization frameworks

scoring_criteria.name: Enterprise SDLC Leadership
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: The role requires directing end-to-end execution at a high organizational level.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Candidates without director experience may struggle with strategic alignment

scoring_criteria.name: Java/Spring Boot Expertise
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Core technical foundation for the platform development.

scoring_criteria.name: Insurance Industry Knowledge
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: The role involves localizing global standards for insurance regulatory environments.

scoring_criteria.name: Cloud & API Fluency
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Essential for modern, scalable, and integrable technology delivery.

scoring_criteria.name: Strategic Planning & Roadmap
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Must link technical output to commercial business objectives.

scoring_criteria.name: Operational Excellence
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Focus is on reducing costs and optimizing workflows.

scoring_criteria.name: Stakeholder Management
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Primary bridge between technical teams and business functional heads.

scoring_criteria.name: Agile Methodology
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Necessary for keeping multiple IT and business teams synchronized.

summary_focus: High-level leadership in digital transformation and large-scale technical delivery
do_not_overclaim: Avoid claiming full-stack development experience if focus is on management/architecture

cover_letter_guidance.positioning: Emphasize ability to translate complex technology roadmaps into tangible insurance business value
bridge_gaps_honestly: Focus on transferable management experience if industry experience is outside insurance
